answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, with the stake sized to the reputation it claims. An attacker riding a rising tide of new identities must fund each one separately, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs from the terrace of verified work. One gale of fake reviews cannot move the market because each identity's influence is capped by its stake, making forgery expensive and detection cheap.
